$comment: Shared vectors of the execution derivation (step 10, contract v1): src-tauri/src/execution/derive.rs and server/src/modules/domain/execution-summary.ts both read this file. Each case feeds the pure core already-linked attempts and checks a subset of the output: every key in `expected` must be equal in the result (arrays element by element, same length); keys not listed are not checked. kind = summary (one project, `filter`) or home (`projects`, `request`).

cases.name: the latest final wins across a manual and an imported run
a newer manual attempt wins again and an old revision is stale
within the latest run the worst configuration wins and equal attempts are decided by id
flaky comes from a retry or from the tool
retest needs a fixed or retest defect and none still being worked
a cycle scope counts the cycle's cells
a plan scope and the plan's own criteria, aligned by index
build filter matches trimmed values and lists the options
the period includes its start and excludes its end; an undated attempt is counted apart
without a period an undated attempt still decides the state of play
daily buckets follow the caller's day starts across a DST change
a deleted run is hidden through the run: its failed result does not count (EJE-07)
medium and low risk bands, skipped and other results, targets per flow and row, defects by severity and status
a known criterion with an unparseable metric has a value but no verdict; a cycle without configurations has one column
home: windows, queues, a project with zero cases and an undated attempt; a deleted run's attempts count nowhere
